translations.web: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.
translations.bsb: When the young woman would go to the king, she was given whatever she requested to take with her from the harem to the king’s palace.
translations.kjv: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.
translations.asv: then in this wise came the maiden unto the king: whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.
